neighbours.label: a list of second pieces of split words: 'SC' in ATSC / NTSC, 'ister' right after a word-initial 'L' (Lister, Listeria), and Cyrillic 'с' after 'От' (отсюда); the same pieces elsewhere (Hollister, Pfister, sister) stay quiet
fire: Most American stations broadcast in ATSC today.
The surgeon Lister washed his instruments in carbolic acid.
Older camcorders record in NTSC only.
The antenna picks up ATSC channels for free.
A Listeria outbreak closed the dairy.
The DVD is encoded in NTSC format.
quiet: Most American stations broadcast in HD today.
The surgeon Pfister washed his instruments in alcohol.
Older camcorders record in PAL only.
The antenna picks up DVB channels for free.
A salmonella outbreak closed the dairy.
My sister encoded the DVD last night.

notes: The pole depends on the preceding piece too, so the declared pieces over-count; 'son' (6 of the top 32) is not covered by this label.
